role: exposure-logged qualitative development evidence, not confirmation
selection: Two public-benchmark sources selected for distinct natural materials: waterfall and campfire; four systems with existing 5s outputs on both.
limitations: Short-window visualization; no long-horizon or model-ranking claim. Visual cross-paper overlap audit is documented separately.

vb161950.text: A tall waterfall dropping from a green cliff onto a gravel plain. Recorded by a fixed tripod camera, unmoving. The cliff faces, the grassy slopes and the gravel bank hold their positions. White water plunges from the lip into the pool top to bottom. Bright midday sun.
